name: @loomwork/chat-agent
description: A chat agent on the R17 conversation layer (owner-only, single user): multi-turn dialogue as one chained execution, barge-in (a new turn interrupts an in-flight answer and the partial is kept, marked interrupted), history rotation + token-window compaction, a process restart after which the client reconnects over SSE with Last-Event-ID and resumes without gaps or duplicates, and a second tenant asking for the first's conversation getting 404. Offline, scripted model, real SSE server on port 0.
